```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Broadband provides Americans with high-speed Internet access connections that improve the nation's economic productivity.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Broadband offers life-enhancing applications, such as distance learning, remote medical diagnostics, and the ability to work from home more effectively.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Broadband technology will enhance the nation's economic competitiveness.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Broadband will help improve education and health care for all Americans.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans have implemented a wide range of policies to create economic incentives, remove regulatory barriers, and promote new technologies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"These policies are essential to making broadband competitively available and affordable.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"President Bush established the goal of providing every American with access to affordable broadband by 2007.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Taxing broadband access would increase its cost to consumers and stifle the extension of broadband service.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The President has signed into law a two-year extension of the Internet Access Tax moratorium.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The President is working with Congressional Republicans to pass legislation that would explicitly extend the Internet Access Tax moratorium to broadband and make it permanent.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Republicans are working to reduce burdensome regulations that discourage broadband investment.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"High-speed Internet access should not be governed by regulations established decades ago for the telephone.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Consumers should have more options for affordable broadband access.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Broadband over power lines and wireless Internet access provide new opportunities to connect households, schools, and businesses to the Internet.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Under the President's leadership, the Administration has nearly doubled the amount of spectrum available for innovative wireless broadband applications such as Wi-Fi and Wi-Max.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
